neighbours.label: capital 'H' as its own token glued to a digit, hyphen or other non-word character ('-H' flag, '4H', 'L3H…', 'xH…'), weaker for a free-standing ' H'; not the H that starts an ordinary word
fire: The satellite rode a Delta 4H from the Florida coast.
Use attrib -S -H to make the folder visible again.
For shading I prefer a 6B, but for fine lines a 2H is better.
The radar was built by L3Harris for the coast guard.
The crates were marked 7H and 9H in red paint.
The bond between C-H atoms is shorter than expected.
quiet: The satellite rode a Delta 4M from the Florida coast.
Use attrib -S -R to make the folder writable again.
For shading I prefer a 6B, but for fine lines a 2B is better.
Harris built the radar for the coast guard in Houston.
The crates were marked 7K and 9K in red paint.
Helen and Hugo walked Home through Hyde Park.
The pH of the sample was checked at the NIH and the WHO.

notes: One token dominates ('H' x26, ' H' x6). Probes: 'curl … -H' 0.97, 'L3Harris' 0.71, 'Delta 4H' 0.69, '4H' pencil 0.67, '2H, 5H' 0.57, 'attrib … -H' 0.48, 'Vitamin H' 0.65 but 'the H key' 0.14; word-initial H (Henry, Home, Hat) 0.08, 'pH … NIH' 0.01, other letters (4M, 2K) 0.00.
